lines.en: - Hey you Lepa from Prilep,
did the lad from Prilep arrive,
hey you Lepa from Prilep,

lines.cyr: дал' ти дојде, дал' ти дојде Прилепчето?
lines.lat: dal' ti dojde, dal' ti dojde Prilepčeto?
lines.en: did the lad from Prilep arrive?
- He came, he came, I wish he didn’t,

lines.cyr: јас му велам јас ќе идам,
lines.lat: jas mu velam jas ḱe idam,
lines.en: I’m telling him that I will go,
he came, he came, I wish he didn’t,

lines.cyr: јас му велам, јас му велам јас ќе идам.
lines.lat: jas mu velam, jas mu velam jas ḱe idam.
lines.en: I’m telling him that I will go.
He says to me, don’t, don’t come,
no do not come, I won’t take you,
he says to me, don’t, don’t come,

lines.cyr: немој нејди, немој не иди, не те земам.
lines.lat: nemoj nejdi, nemoj ne idi, ne te zemam.
lines.en: no do not come, I won’t take you.
Over there I have friends,
friends, my best friends,
over there I have friends,
friends, friends, my best friends.
They will leave me a fool,
you, maiden, they will fall in love with you,
they will leave me a fool,

lines.cyr: тебе младо, тебе младо ќе заљубат.
lines.lat: tebe mlado, tebe mlado ḱe zaljubat.
lines.en: you, maiden, they will fall in love with you.
